subject.title: [Feature]: Talk/Voice tab — agent/session switching + per-agent TTS voice

question: Should the remaining Talk/Voice target selector land Android-first using existing chat agent/session state, or wait for a shared Android/iOS/macOS Talk UX decision?
rationale: Current source shows a clear Android Voice/Talk gap, but iOS and macOS already route Talk through active chat/session state differently, so maintainers need to choose the product boundary before implementation.

options.title: Android-first Talk selector
options.body: Add a focused Android Voice/Talk target selector that reuses existing gateway agent/session state while leaving iOS/macOS unchanged unless a concrete parity gap is found.

options.title: Shared companion Talk UX
options.body: Pause implementation until Android, iOS, and macOS agree on one Talk/Voice target-selection model and proof plan.

options.title: Track TTS only elsewhere
options.body: Close the selector portion and leave only per-agent TTS/STT follow-up in the existing voice override issues, accepting that Android Talk remains default-routed for now.

recommendation.title: Android-first Talk selector
recommendation.body: Add a focused Android Voice/Talk target selector that reuses existing gateway agent/session state while leaving iOS/macOS unchanged unless a concrete parity gap is found.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter scoped the issue after the TTS implementation and is the strongest history signal for deciding whether the remaining selector should be Android-first or cross-platform.
